items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, Sheik lives down there now, though. [INTERVIEWEE] Sheik, no. Sheik, I told him, she can't eat anything. I must have been a baby. Couldn't have been born there.

ctx.x: Well, Sheik lives down there now, though.
Sheik, no. Sheik, I told him, she can't eat anything. I must have been a baby. Couldn't have been born there. And who else?
Well, let me ask you about Joe Hoodoo then. What did they call him that?
